scope: C# actual typed/cooperative immutable value construction; no event/scope/runtime/entry-byte qualification.

criteria.sourceDescription: Integer-number input outside inclusive -9007199254740991 through 9007199254740991 is rejected; explicit integer strings and decimal strings preserve their documented type.
criteria.appliedMeaning: Real integer constructors accept inclusive safe extrema and reject adjacent/native long extrema; explicit numeric text keeps kind, precision and magnitude.

criteria.sourceDescription: Mutating any original nested collection after capture cannot alter owned values; unsupported or cyclic/excessively nested input terminates with a bounded rejection.
criteria.appliedMeaning: Owned nested graphs survive caller mutations. Typed API/actual compiler controls exclude arbitrary/cyclic object graphs. Cooperative structural oversize is bounded and truncated under the explicit user amendment; observed invalid prefixes reject. Blocking callbacks and unsafe reflection-created graphs are outside the supported surface.

criteria.sourceDescription: The attribute root counts as depth 1 and one node, and boundary fixtures distinguish exactly-at-limit from over-limit input.
criteria.appliedMeaning: Actual map/array roots count as depth 1/node 1; neutral exact/over limits and independently measured native/Python outputs qualify depth 8/node 1024 with repeated containment and partial descendants.

criteria.sourceDescription: No input automatically changes JSON type as its magnitude grows, and rejected input is available to the caller as a stable capture error for InvalidEvent accounting.
criteria.appliedMeaning: Actual constructor kinds remain explicit for numeric magnitude and normalized strings. Invalid typed inputs return stable argument categories/parameters without raw value echo, available to callers; logger InvalidEvent counting is later runtime work.
